productGoal: A simple mobile-first worldwide Christian saints and liturgical calendar that is complete enough to be useful every day, remains current without daily human intervention, and turns verified data into personalized calendars, discovery, pilgrimages and live experiences.

modes.name: Initial exhaustive baseline
modes.purpose: Create the first globally useful content baseline before judging the product by automation maturity.
successMetrics: no empty Today for launched calendars where the Church has observances
person identity resolved across launched calendars
complete public locale labels for launched locales
published D1 baseline available to the public product
work: select authoritative calendar sources per Church and jurisdiction
perform full source acquisition for the baseline horizon
normalize saints, observances, ranks, date rules and jurisdictions
resolve duplicate people without merging Church-specific observances
build multilingual names and locale-safe structured summaries
validate calendar dates and theology-specific terminology
publish approved baseline to production D1
modes.stopCondition: All launched calendar+locale combinations meet product coverage thresholds; BUILD then becomes backfill-only for newly added Churches, jurisdictions or locales.
mustNot: run forever as a full recrawl
treat Wikidata or Vatican as a universal Christian calendar
publish a Church before its calendar authority and terminology are understood
count staging records as product completion

modes.name: Indefinite incremental maintenance
modes.purpose: Keep the published baseline correct indefinitely with bounded, source-aware delta checks.
successMetrics: official calendar changes detected and propagated
new saints, beatifications, canonizations or Church-specific recognitions added
work: use ETag, Last-Modified, hashes or source-specific cursors before full fetch
fetch and normalize only changed records when possible
re-run identity and language review only for deltas
auto-promote only sources and claim types explicitly approved for automatic publication
mustNot: repeat the initial global baseline every hour
trigger Cloudflare Worker builds for content changes
allow a source to approve itself
replace verified content with a failed or ambiguous fetch

modes.name: Smart product mechanics
modes.purpose: Turn verified canonical data into the simple user-facing SantosDia product.
successMetrics: Today is correct for user timezone, Church, jurisdiction and locale
calendar navigation is useful on mobile
smart ICS/webcal feeds stay correct without manual regeneration
search resolves localized names and aliases to the same person
pilgrimage and live surfaces are filtered by date, place, Church and language
no unsupported-language content leaks into a selected public locale
mechanics: official live-stream schedule and health resolution
ranking by relevance, date, proximity and user-selected Church
mustNot: perform external OSINT acquisition during a user request
translate theology or Church recognition dynamically
invent observances for Churches without them
fall back silently to English on a complete public locale

executionOrder: Finish BUILD for the first launched calendars and locales
Expose that approved baseline in the mobile product
Keep LIVE running only as maintenance of the published baseline
Expand INTELLIGENCE features only when they consume real published content
Repeat BUILD only for a newly launched Church, jurisdiction, locale or content domain

required: Today has verified content for the target date/calendar or an explicit theologically valid no-observance state
selected public locale is end-to-end complete
calendar pages and search use the same canonical data
ICS/webcal uses the same canonical data
production reads published data rather than staging-only datasets
